title: Saber arrived late
text: The saber arrived two weeks late. I want to know if I can get my money back. I did not name an amount.

title: Do not buy from Jedi Pack
text: This is a public complaint. The photo on the listing does not match the saber I received. I will keep this review up.

title: Beautiful saber
text: The saber is beautiful and the hilt feels solid. Five stars.
